p0_recommendations: Introduce TextContainer as the primary movable note unit and place table inline inside it.
Implement OneNote-like selection model: lasso/select ink, select container, multi-select and move together.
Separate Normal Mode and Debug Mode; remove debug overlays and stress controls from normal drawing UX.
Deprecate automatic block-level anchoring in Normal Mode and prefer explicit group movement.
Upgrade export from summary-style outputs to layout-preserving visual exports for table+ink composition.
